answer: Vouched bonding makes each extra identity pay a 39.6 xDAI deposit and two vouchers staking seats; a farm running N fakes pays N×39.6 xDAI and cannot share it because one voucher's bond covers one newcomer, burning with it. A farm that tries to forge one voucher ring dies by joint-slash audit at 2: the second fake on one voucher burns both bonds and both seats as challengers press like a tide at a jetty. Each reused voucher costs the farm its backers.
